description: Commitfest entries whose latest cfbot build fails on a platform: cf_id, title, entry_status, needs_rebase (the build is of an older version: the newest does not apply), commitfest_number. Cite https://commitfest.postgresql.org/patch/<cf_id>/.

platform.description: Failing on: linux, macos, windows, freebsd, netbsd or openbsd

status.description: Entry status, e.g. needs-review (default every active status)

name: find_failing_patches
